newsitem.title: UK: Berkeley to issue shares to finance buys.
newsitem.headline: Berkeley to issue shares to finance buys.

text.p: British housebuilder and property developer Berkeley Group Plc said on Friday it was planning to issue for cash 4.75 million shares in order to finance proposed acquisitions.
A Berkeley executive told Reuters the company planned to raise around 32 million stg from the proposed sale of shares being placed by SBC Warburg.
The number of shares represents around five percent of Berkeley's new ordinary share capital.
Meanwhile, the company said its sale reservations had continued strong and had exceeded its expectations in January.
"Current trading therefore is buoyant and the outlook for the full year to 30 April 1997 is very positive," it said.
